core: Neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis
name: Neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis during axis elongation
rationale: Members cover notochord/axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate/fold morphogenesis; convergent extension, paraxial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis separate it from neural plate patterning and spinal cord patterning neighbours.

core: Lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
name: Lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern lateral plate mesoderm formation, mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike neighbours centred on gastrulation, primitive streak and endoderm or cardiac specification.

name: Prostate gland and genital tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members span prostate bud, branching and acinus development plus uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia morphogenesis, distinguishing it from mammary, gonadal sex determination and salivary branching neighbours.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members cover SLBP-dependent and independent histone pre-mRNA 3' processing, Pol II termination and mature mRNA export; histone stem-loop processing separates it from general RNA export neighbours and mRNA export from polyadenylation neighbours.

core: Vascular wall endothelium and smooth muscle
name: Vascular shear-stress response and aortic smooth muscle development
rationale: Members concern endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear, SRF-driven contractile smooth muscle and aorta development, whereas neighbours centre on smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration.

qualifier: amino sugar and sialic acid precursors with GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects and GPI anchor synthesis, unlike neighbours focused on N-glycan processing, fucose and glycosphingolipid synthesis.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle centred on reverse transcription and integration
rationale: All members are HIV-1 life-cycle steps from entry and uncoating through reverse transcription, PIC import and integration to Rev export and Env; this separates it from HCMV, other RNA viruses and retroelement restriction neighbours.

qualifier: Sema3A repulsion, collateral sprouting and peripheral regeneration
name: Axon outgrowth inhibition, Sema3A repulsion and nerve regeneration
rationale: Members concern axon growth stimulation and inhibition, Sema3A/CRMP repulsion, collateral sprouting and peripheral axon regeneration, which neighbours focused on netrin, ephrin and Slit guidance lack.

qualifier: centrosome maturation kinases and cleavage furrow
name: Mitotic spindle assembly, centrosome maturation and cleavage furrow formation
rationale: Members cover AURKA/PLK1/NEK-driven centrosome maturation, spindle assembly and checkpoint, and contractile ring/cytokinesis, unlike neighbours on spindle orientation, nuclear envelope reformation or chromosome cohesion and condensation.

name: Male sex determination and testis differentiation
rationale: Members concern male sex determination, gonadal mesoderm, testis transcriptional control, AMH signalling and Leydig cells, distinguishing it from germ cell/Sertoli, ovarian and genital tract neighbours.

name: Type I interferon signalling, ISG effectors and feedback attenuation
rationale: Members cover IFN-alpha/beta signalling, ISG15, OAS and PKR antiviral effectors and negative regulation of the pathway, whereas neighbours are virus-sensing and antiviral signature modules.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
name: Synapse assembly, trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
rationale: Members concern pre/postsynaptic assembly, neurexin-neuroligin adhesion, receptor clustering and dendrite/spine development, which neighbours on LTP and memory, vesicle recycling or glutamate receptor activation lack.

qualifier: dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing
name: Chemokine signalling in dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing
rationale: Members cover chemokines and their receptors, myeloid dendritic cell chemotaxis and maturation, and lymphocyte homing adhesion, unlike neighbours on NK, T cell or monocyte migration and CCR7 signalling.

qualifier: TAK1 activation and programmed cell death
name: TRIF-dependent TLR signalling to TAK1 and cell death
rationale: Members concern TLR3/TLR4 TRIF/TICAM1 signalling through RIP1, TRAF6-TAK1 and TRIF-mediated cell death, distinguishing it from MyD88/IRAK, IRF3 activation and cytokine production neighbours.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT-regulated muscle adaptation, atrophy and fibre-type switching
rationale: Members cover cardiac and skeletal muscle adaptation, stress hypertrophy, disuse atrophy, fibre-type transition and calcineurin-NFAT signalling, which neighbours on muscle growth, cell size and sarcomere organisation lack.

name: Late endosome-Golgi exchange and COPI-independent retrograde traffic
rationale: Members concern endosome-Golgi transport, Golgi retention and COPI-independent Golgi-to-ER traffic, unlike neighbours on COPI vesicles, lysosome biogenesis or endocytic recycling.

name: Epidermal keratinization and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, hair follicle, sebaceous gland, nail and tooth/odontogenesis and EDA-ID ectodermal dysplasia, distinguishing it from adhesion, wound healing, pigmentation and intestinal epithelium neighbours.

name: TLR7/8/9 and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing regulation
rationale: Members regulate endosomal TLR7/8/9 and cGAS-STING signalling, TREX1, cGAMP import and IFN-beta, unlike neighbours on RNA helicase IFN induction, ADAR editing or TLR3 deficiency.

name: Myeloid inflammatory activation via neutrophil degranulation and complement receptors
rationale: Members are neutrophil/monocyte inflammatory activation modules with degranulation and complement receptor signalling, unlike neighbours on formyl peptide chemotaxis, SIRP inhibition or generic myeloid identity.

name: Stress granule dynamics and TTP-family mRNA destabilisation
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly and disassembly under arsenite and PKR signalling plus TTP, BRF1 and KSRP mRNA decay, distinguishing it from heat shock, HuR/AUF1 stabilisation and proteolysis neighbours.

name: Nucleoside and nucleoside-analogue drug transport with xenobiotic efflux
rationale: Members concern purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport, abacavir and ribavirin handling and xenobiotic export, unlike neighbours on nucleotide interconversion, thiopurine metabolism and mitochondrial nucleotide transport.

core: Endocardial cushion and heart valve morphogenesis
name: Endocardial cushion EMT, heart valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardium, cushion EMT and fusion, all four valves and atrial/ventricular septa, whereas neighbours concern myocardium, trabeculae and ventricle formation.

name: Transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism and sulfide oxidation
rationale: Members cover homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfur amino acid catabolism and hydrogen sulfide oxidation, unlike selenium, glutathione and FMO/choline neighbours.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and TGF-beta EMT signalling
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and adherens junction assembly; TGF-beta EMT and promotion of cadherin adhesion separate it from polarity, CDH1 turnover and CDH11 neighbours.

qualifier: dietary hexose absorption, galactose, fructose and pentose
name: Dietary hexose absorption and galactose, fructose and pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover intestinal sugar digestion and hexose transport plus Leloir galactose, fructose, pentose phosphate non-oxidative and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism, unlike glycogen, glycolysis and gluconeogenesis neighbours.
